description: Lints every edited file with the project's own oxlint config (or deno check/deno lint for Deno-shebang files) and feeds violations back with a diagnostic that demands new skill invocations before fixing.

hooks.command: command -v deno >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo 'oxlint-guard-hook: deno not found on PATH - install Deno (https://deno.land) so the lint guard can run' >&2; exit 1; }; exec deno run --quiet --config "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/deno.jsonc" --allow-read --allow-run --allow-env "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/src/lint-guard.ts"
